title: VICTORY LANE! | COPICafe Episode 44 | Cornucopias
description:
In this episode of COPI Cafe, Rob and Josh feature a brand new track released by Se7en! They then go on to discuss some new updates relating to staking on Cardano. Rob then shows some interesting stats on the COPI stake pool. Rob goes on to talk about a poker tournament held by the Knights Guild. Josh gives an update on internal racing and the strategy behind focusing on this aspect of the game. Josh and Rob then give an inside look onto why we share content of the games progress in real time. The guys then go on to answer some community questions from discord. Finally, they go on to share an exciting new leak! 

Se7ens video: https://twitter.com/7even_music/status/1625933048888819730?s=46&t=jBNBQdxZJpdJuhEJ5i5EIg

00:00 Beverage Choices
01:27 7Evens Video
02:50 Staking
05:02 COPI Stake Pool
07:37 Poker Tournament
10:47 Internal Racing
12:38 Why we share content
20:50 Community Questions
28:09 Leaks!
